reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: p0042 imposes a symmetric consent requirement with no affiliate/successor carve-out for Company, no bar on assignment to a Company competitor, and no change-of-control clarification, which is a genuine gap against the ASSIGN preferred position.

The redline is additive and preserves the original sentence verbatim, appending (i) Company's consent-free assignment to affiliates and M&A successors, (ii) a bar on Contractor assigning to a Company competitor, and (iii) confirmation that a Company change of control is not an assignment and gives Contractor no termination, suspension or re-pricing right — precisely the redline guidance.

The failed 'minimal edit' check reflects only the length of the appended proviso relative to a short original clause; no existing language was deleted or altered, so the edit is the smallest one that reaches the playbook position.
The comment accurately describes each change, cites the playbook position, offers the mutual-successor fallback, and matches the required tone and prefix.

Rationale's factual claims are consistent with the supplied text (no Contractor change-of-control exit or re-pricing right elsewhere is asserted, and Section 6 is noted as unrelated), so no walk-away trigger is mischaracterized.
